answer.recommendedPath: Contract for a licensed MLB headshot feed, map its player identifier to the existing entity-resolution layer, and populate the existing local headshotUrl contract.

sources.name: MLB digital properties
sources.finding: MLB materials may not be commercially reproduced or displayed without written permission; an accessible image URL is not a commercial-use license.
sources.decision: Do not hotlink MLB CDN headshots.

sources.name: SportsDataIO Player Headshots
sources.finding: Licensed MLB headshots are available through USA Today/IMAGN-backed packages and transparent-background options.
sources.decision: Strongest direct fit for a headshot-only integration; requires sales access and pricing.

sources.name: Sportradar Images API
sources.finding: MLB player headshots are available through production image feeds with provider, manifest, asset, and size contracts.
sources.decision: Strong fit if OddSphere also wants a broader licensed sports editorial image platform.

integrationShape.existingUiContract: PlayerPropPreviewRow.headshotUrl already accepts safe local paths and falls back when unavailable.
integrationShape.identityWarning: BDL IDs must not be treated as MLBAM, SportsDataIO, or Sportradar IDs without verified mapping.
